code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):

                continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
            if all(grid[r0][x]==color and grid[r1][x]==color for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[y][c0]==color and grid[y][c1]==color for y in range(r0,r1+1)):
                fill=7 if (c1-c0-1)%2==1 else 2
                for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                    for x in range(c0+1,c1): out[y][x]=fill
    return out
'''
